title: pgAssistant - Query Workload
description: Ranked SQL workload correlated with Executive Plan team ownership when a Team is selected.

list.name: team
list.label: Team
list.query: SELECT '__ALL__' AS __value, 'All' AS __text UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT team AS __value, team AS __text FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND team IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 2

list.name: environment
list.label: Environment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(environment,'unknown') AS __value, coalesce(environment,'unknown') AS __text FROM pga_collection_run ORDER BY 1

list.name: target_id
list.label: Target
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT target_id AS __value, coalesce(target_name,target_id) AS __text FROM pga_collection_run WHERE coalesce(environment,'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 2

list.name: priority
list.label: Priority
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT priority_level AS __value, priority_level AS __text FROM pga_ranked_query_snapshot WHERE priority_level IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.name: queryid
list.label: Query ID
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT queryid AS __value, queryid AS __text FROM pga_ranked_query_snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) AND queryid IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target_id) run_id FROM pga_ranked_query_snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY target_id,collected_at DESC) SELECT count(*) FROM pga_ranked_query_snapshot q JOIN latest l USING(run_id) JOIN pga_collection_run r ON r.run_id=q.run_id WHERE q.priority_level IN (${priority:sqlstring}) AND q.queryid IN (${queryid:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(r.environment,'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND ('__ALL__' IN (${team:sqlstring}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot x CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(x.query_ids) j(queryid) WHERE x.target_id=q.target_id AND x.team IN (${team:sqlstring}) AND j.queryid=q.queryid));

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target_id) run_id FROM pga_ranked_query_snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY target_id,collected_at DESC) SELECT sum(q.total_exec_time_ms) FROM pga_ranked_query_snapshot q JOIN latest l USING(run_id) WHERE q.priority_level IN (${priority:sqlstring}) AND q.queryid IN (${queryid:sqlstring}) AND ('__ALL__' IN (${team:sqlstring}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot x CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(x.query_ids) j(queryid) WHERE x.target_id=q.target_id AND x.team IN (${team:sqlstring}) AND j.queryid=q.queryid));

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target_id) run_id FROM pga_ranked_query_snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY target_id,collected_at DESC) SELECT sum(q.calls) FROM pga_ranked_query_snapshot q JOIN latest l USING(run_id) WHERE q.priority_level IN (${priority:sqlstring}) AND q.queryid IN (${queryid:sqlstring}) AND ('__ALL__' IN (${team:sqlstring}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot x CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(x.query_ids) j(queryid) WHERE x.target_id=q.target_id AND x.team IN (${team:sqlstring}) AND j.queryid=q.queryid));

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target_id) run_id FROM pga_ranked_query_snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY target_id,collected_at DESC) SELECT max(q.priority_score) FROM pga_ranked_query_snapshot q JOIN latest l USING(run_id) WHERE q.priority_level IN (${priority:sqlstring}) AND q.queryid IN (${queryid:sqlstring}) AND ('__ALL__' IN (${team:sqlstring}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot x CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(x.query_ids) j(queryid) WHERE x.target_id=q.target_id AND x.team IN (${team:sqlstring}) AND j.queryid=q.queryid));

SELECT q.collected_at AS time,q.target_id || ' / ' || q.queryid AS metric,q.priority_score FROM pga_ranked_query_snapshot q JOIN pga_collection_run r ON r.run_id=q.run_id WHERE $__timeFilter(q.collected_at) AND q.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) AND q.priority_level IN (${priority:sqlstring}) AND q.queryid IN (${queryid:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(r.environment,'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND ('__ALL__' IN (${team:sqlstring}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot x CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(x.query_ids) j(queryid) WHERE x.target_id=q.target_id AND x.team IN (${team:sqlstring}) AND j.queryid=q.queryid)) ORDER BY 1;

SELECT q.collected_at AS time,q.target_id || ' / ' || q.queryid AS metric,q.mean_exec_time_ms FROM pga_ranked_query_snapshot q JOIN pga_collection_run r ON r.run_id=q.run_id WHERE $__timeFilter(q.collected_at) AND q.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) AND q.priority_level IN (${priority:sqlstring}) AND q.queryid IN (${queryid:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(r.environment,'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND ('__ALL__' IN (${team:sqlstring}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot x CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(x.query_ids) j(queryid) WHERE x.target_id=q.target_id AND x.team IN (${team:sqlstring}) AND j.queryid=q.queryid)) ORDER BY 1;

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target_id) run_id FROM pga_ranked_query_snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY target_id,collected_at DESC) SELECT q.target_id,q.rank_position,q.queryid,q.priority_level,round(q.priority_score,2) AS priority_score,q.calls,round(q.total_exec_time_ms,2) AS total_exec_time_ms,round(q.mean_exec_time_ms,2) AS mean_exec_time_ms,round(q.cache_hit_ratio,2) AS cache_hit_ratio,q.shared_blks_read,q.temp_blks_written,q.wal_bytes,q.reason,q.query FROM pga_ranked_query_snapshot q JOIN latest l USING(run_id) JOIN pga_collection_run r ON r.run_id=q.run_id WHERE q.priority_level IN (${priority:sqlstring}) AND q.queryid IN (${queryid:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(r.environment,'unknown') IN (${environment:sqlstring}) AND ('__ALL__' IN (${team:sqlstring}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pga_executive_plan_recommendation_snapshot x CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(x.query_ids) j(queryid) WHERE x.target_id=q.target_id AND x.team IN (${team:sqlstring}) AND j.queryid=q.queryid)) ORDER BY q.priority_score DESC NULLS LAST,q.total_exec_time_ms DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 500;
